evidence.quote: Debezium Cassandar connector does not run in Kafka Connect as the others. Please check https://github.com/debezium/debezium-examples/tree/main/tutorial#using-cassandra - valid for Debezium 2.x

notes: The 2.x Cassandra connector is a standalone process, not a Kafka Connect source; deploying it in Connect gives an NPE in BaseSourceTask that looks like a bug. Not confirmed by reporter.
